zoe_sec: Heads-up: we're rolling out a company-wide change to privileged session tokens. New org policy will enforce max session TTL of 1h for service principals and interactive sessions. Effective 2026-04-01.

devin_platform: What triggers enforcement? Is it an org policy or IAM change?

zoe_sec: It's an org policy + auth proxy enforcement in the control plane. Any token issued with TTL > 1h will be rejected at issuance. Existing long-lived tokens won't be auto-rotated, teams must rotate before 2026-04-01.

harry_sre: Any exceptions for long-running batch jobs? We have nightly retrain jobs that run ~3h.

zoe_sec: Exceptions: short-term scoped roles via STS that can be refreshed automatically; for batch jobs we recommend assuming a role on start and refreshing with STS every 45m. If you need a temporary exception, file S-5522 with justification. Exceptions are time-limited and require sec approval.

ci-bot: [automated] Created ticket S-5522: "Privileged session TTL enforcement & exception requests". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/S-5522

devin_platform: Plan for platform: add client library helper that transparently renews STS tokens for jobs and update docs. ETA 1 week for libs, 3 days for docs.

zoe_sec: Also pushing a pre-enforcement scanner next week that will flag images and configs with static credentials or embedded long TTLs. Teams will get warnings 7 days before enforcement.

harry_sre: Noted. We'll audit cron jobs and convert any static tokens to role-assume flows.

security-bot: [automated] Queued scan for 'session_duration' and 'aws_session_token' patterns in repos and infra configs. ETA ~30m.

zoe_sec: Communication plan: email to service-owners@redwood today, follow-up reminders at 7d and 24h. Docs: https://internal.redwood.com/security/session-ttl-change . Reach out if you need help with migration.

devin_platform: Thanks — tagging eng-sre and ml-teams channels with migration checklist.

zoe_sec: Closing thread; follow-ups in S-5522. If you see any tokens >1h, DM me directly. :lock:
